limitations: Evidence-only verification cannot prove absence of unlogged raw-data access; source and logs record zero test images/predictions.
Only one fixed validation split; seed42 is selected among 6 configurations, so its peak score is selected and optimistic.
Confirmation seeds validate variation without reselecting; n=3 mean/std is descriptive, not a confidence interval or significance claim.
MobileNet V2 versus ResNet18 V1 ImageNet pretraining recipes differ; report comparison as complete specified pipelines.
MPS bitwise determinism is not guaranteed.

Unix start times and monotonic elapsed durations cannot be strictly concatenated: one mixed-clock derived gap is -0.0411s. The controller synchronously waits for each worker; source and increasing starts support sequential execution, but no single-clock per-worker end timestamps were captured. This is an audit limitation, not evidence of overlapping fits.
Held-out test and E1 remain deferred to new P4 authorization; no safety or real-world generalization claim.
Bounded HPO config retains prior S1 pending-decision text; explicit committed S2 approved_vision_budget.json is the newer applicable budget authorization.
